answer: Escrowed deposits plus a referral graph stop fake identities. A newcomer locks 30 POA, names a sponsor, and the referral is written in an ivory ledger, so the graph stays crystal clear: one sponsor with a thousand referrals is a farm, and a lantern audit flags it. A peer may dispute a suspect; a fake loses its 30 POA and its sponsor loses 15 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 45,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps its rewards whole.
